name: French Horn
author: Versilian Studios (samples); DAW build script
attribution: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition (Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0
desc: Solo French horn, sustained, 2 dynamics. Round, noble, mellow; brassy when loud. Range A1-F5 (best C3-C5). Heroic themes, warm chord pads, film swells. | Playable MIDI 33-77 (A1-F5), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Legato melody: overlap consecutive notes by ~30 ms (next note starts before the previous ends) with glide 0.03-0.06; wide leaps crossfade naturally (legato=1), legato=0 = pure slide.
